title: At the pharmacy
caption:
At a Russian pharmacy, one pattern does it all: У меня́ боли́т + body part.
У меня́ боли́т голова́ = I have a headache. У меня́ боли́т го́рло = I have a sore throat.
Save this for your trip. What would you say first?
